description: The cheapest thing an insurgency does and the one that scales: paint, at night, on somebody else's property. Watchful band, so it is usually the first thing a player sees a cell do.
name: Somebody has been at the walls

stage.author: nobody
stage.text: THE BASIN IS NOT A BODY

lines: The paint on the shutter is still tacky at the edges.
Somebody has gone over the same three words twice, in case.
A shopkeeper is scrubbing at a wall and getting nowhere.

stage.text: Somebody did the whole row in {place} last night. Took them one can and about four minutes.
